setup.dynamic_definition: Previous-round edge input is zeroed before every CGNN inference round; pair state is recomputed from the current round's node states.
setup.recurrent_definition: Edge state is reset at every TB boundary but passed/refined from CGNN round 1 to round 2 within the same TB.

verdict: No evidence that carrying/refining pair state across CGNN inference rounds helps. Dynamic and recurrent modes produced identical TBLER at every tested Eb/N0 point and the same 10% TBLER crossing; both are effectively identical to the cold K=2 baseline. Do not pursue recurrent intra-TB edge state under this tested architecture.
